title: Derived internal hom of module objects
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and $X$ a scheme. Put $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$, the commutative ring object of [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and let $\Mod_{\Lambda_X}=\Mod_{\Lambda_X}(\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab))$ be the category of module objects of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Write $\mathcal D=D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$ for its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with the relative derived tensor product of [def-sfb-derived-tensor-modules].

The *derived internal hom* is the internal-hom bifunctor of this closed monoidal structure [lem-sfb-derived-monoidal-closed]:
$$
\RHom_{\Lambda_X}(-,-)\colon\mathcal D^{\mathrm{op}}\times\mathcal D\longrightarrow\mathcal D.
$$
Explicitly, for fixed $K\in\mathcal D$, $\RHom_{\Lambda_X}(K,-)$ is the right adjoint supplied by the closed structure to $K\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\Lambda_X}-$; its defining adjunction has bijections
$$
\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(K\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\Lambda_X}M,N)
\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(M,\RHom_{\Lambda_X}(K,N)).
$$
The dependence on $K$ is contravariant and that on $N$ is covariant, as in the internal hom of any closed monoidal category.
